subject: USAF - Data Science Metadata Mgmt & Enterprise Learning App Spt - MRAS
snippet: Dear GSA Industry Partner: Link to the RFI: Take the survey Your company has been identified as a GSA Contractor that can potentially meet the needs of the below RFI and we would like to invite your
description: Data Science, Metadata Management, and Enterprise Learning Application Support (ELAS) for Department of the Air Force (DAF), Headquarters (HQ) Air Education Training Command (AETC), Analysis and Assessments Directorate (HQ AETC/A9), HQ AETC Data Office (HQ AETC/A6), and HQ AETC Learning Services Division (HQ AETC/A3G). AETC requires non-personal professional and technical services. The contractor will operate as part of a Government-led MFT and provide qualified personnel to perform operations research, data science, AI/ML, enterprise data mgmt, software development, and application sustainment activities.
